old_problem: The Procedure says only 'NVQual Test' without module, version or subtests. Its blast radius could range from passive reads to traffic, retrain, reset or power actions, and generic GPU/link snapshots do not define ConnectX-8 qualification or its acceptance.
disposition_reason: ED-03 allows standard drafts but forbids guessing OEM/vendor command parameters. Here the missing artifact is the core vendor operation and authoritative Expected Result, not merely target IP/BDF. Without the module specification, review cannot safely preserve exact coverage, identify side effects or define recovery, so Pending is retained.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2148, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2149 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00026-V002 / 13b756b697945630 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Owner/FAE must provide the licensed pinned ConnectX-8 NVQual module/version, complete subtest/action list and vendor instructions; presumed reset/power behavior is not adopted.
Each subtest must declare target, traffic/retrain/reset/power/firmware/link-policy effects, iterations/timing, authoritative link/function/error acceptance and recovery.
After module selection bind ConnectX-8 serial/PN/port/BDF and root-port/switch/retimer topology plus supported/expected generation/width.
Preserve/hash PCIe/NIC/host/BMC baselines and approve disruptive actions individually. Stop before any unnamed or unreviewed action and at first target/link/AER/driver/platform fault.
No generic GPU snapshot or alternative suite may substitute unless every required subtest and oracle is explicitly mapped.
No NVQual action, NIC/PCIe query, log clearing, traffic/retrain/reset/power/firmware action, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.purpose: Qualify the exact designated ConnectX-8 endpoint and host PCIe path using the owner-approved NVQual module and prove every defined subtest meets its link, function and error oracle without hang or reboot.
required_package: Licensed pinned ConnectX-8 NVQual module/version, full subtest list and vendor instructions
Signed ConnectX-8 serial/PN/port/BDF and root-port/switch/retimer/max-link map
Per-subtest action, side-effect, iteration/timing and authoritative acceptance matrix
Dedicated drained SUT and point approval for every disruptive boundary
BMC/console, first-fault interlock and vendor recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED pending the exact NVQual module/action specification. Do not run a generic command. After owner approval, preserve baselines and execute only reviewed subtests one at a time against the bound ConnectX-8 path, retaining raw module, PCIe capability/state/AER, NIC/driver and platform evidence. Stop before any unspecified destructive action or on first fault; do not retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every approved subtest completes on the exact endpoint/path and satisfies its vendor/project link, function and error oracle with no unexplained state change, hang or reboot; final target/path health is restored as specified.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until module, subtests, effects and authoritative criteria are supplied. PASS requires complete accepted evidence for every approved required subtest. FAIL on wrong target/action, missing coverage, link/device/driver/AER/platform fault, hang/reboot or failed recovery. Missing module/oracle is BLOCKED; generic link-up or GPU evidence is insufficient.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until exact vendor module, action/evidence matrix and recovery are approved.
Treat all unknown subtests as potentially disruptive and require point authorization after read-only prechecks.
Preserve baseline evidence; use an isolated drained SUT with BMC/console.
Stop before ambiguity and without automatic retry on first fault.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, licensed module/version and reviewed subtest/action matrix
ConnectX-8 stable identity and complete PCIe path/max-link topology
Per-action raw NVQual output, parameters, timestamps, target and completion status
Per-action PCIe capability/state/AER, NIC inventory/driver/firmware/counters, kernel/BMC/SEL/thermal/power evidence
First-fault/vendor recovery or clean final target/path state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: If a subtest is unspecified or creates an unexpected action/state, stop before continuing and preserve artifacts. On link/device/driver/platform fault follow the module-specific approved recovery; do not infer reset/power escalation or retry automatically, and quarantine if health is uncertain.
